python3 - << 'PY'
import re, pathlib, collections

files = [
  "apps/playground/src/App.tsx",
  "apps/playground/src/SceneGraphDAG.tsx",
  "apps/playground/src/BehaviorTreeView.tsx",
  "apps/playground/src/AgentPanel.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/WidgetHost.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/SpatialCanvas.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/ThreeCanvas.tsx",
]

# also include timeline styles
files.append("packages/widgets/src/timeline/styles.css")

pattern = re.compile(r'#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}\b')

for f in files:
    text = pathlib.Path(f).read_text()
    for m in pattern.finditer(text):
        start = max(0, m.start()-80)
        end = min(len(text), m.end()+80)
        ctx = text[start:end].replace('\n','\\n')
        hexv = m.group(0)
        # try to detect property
        # look back for something like "background" or "color" or "border"
        # simple heuristic: find last colon before
        before = text[start:m.start()]
        # find property name
        prop_match = re.search(r'([a-zA-Z-]+)\s*:\s*[^;]*$', before)
        prop = prop_match.group(1) if prop_match else ""
        print(f"{f}:{m.start()} {hexv} prop={prop} ctx={ctx[:120]}")
PY

import json, pathlib, re

mapping = json.loads(pathlib.Path("/tmp/final_map.json").read_text())
# sort keys by length descending to avoid partial replacement
sorted_keys = sorted(mapping.keys(), key=lambda k: len(k), reverse=True)

files = [
  "apps/playground/src/App.tsx",
  "apps/playground/src/SceneGraphDAG.tsx",
  "apps/playground/src/BehaviorTreeView.tsx",
  "apps/playground/src/AgentPanel.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/WidgetHost.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/PropertiesPanel.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/SpatialCanvas.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/ThreeCanvas.tsx",
  "packages/widgets/src/timeline/styles.css",
]

for f in files:
    text = pathlib.Path(f).read_text()
    orig = text
    for k in sorted_keys:
        v = mapping[k]
        # pattern: hex literal preceded not by &, and followed by word boundary, case-insensitive
        # Use re.escape for k, but k starts with #
        # We need to handle case-insensitive: pattern with (?i)
        # Also ensure we don't replace inside longer hex? But sorted longest first handles.
        pattern = re.compile(r'(?<!&)' + re.escape(k) + r'\b', re.IGNORECASE)
        text = pattern.sub(v, text)
    if text != orig:
        pathlib.Path(f).write_text(text)
        print(f"updated {f}")
        # count remaining hex
        rem = len(re.findall(r'(?<!&)#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}\b', text))
        print(f"  remaining hex: {rem}")
    else:
        print(f"no change {f}")

                transition: 'background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, justify-content 0.2s',
                boxShadow: 'inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
args.replace:
<button
              role="switch"
              aria-checked={theme === 'light'}
              aria-label={`Toggle theme, currently ${theme}`}
              title={`Switch to ${theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'} theme — ${theme === 'dark' ? 'click for light' : 'click for dark'}`}
              onClick={toggleTheme}
              style={{
                position: 'relative',
                width: 52,
                height: 28,
                borderRadius: 14,
                padding: 2,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: theme === 'dark' ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end',
                background: theme === 'dark' ? 'var(--color-border-strong)' : 'var(--color-button-primary-bg)',
                border: '1px solid var(--color-border-subtle)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                transition: 'background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s',
                boxShadow: 'inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >

args.command:
pnpm typecheck 2>&1 | head -n 20
echo "==="
pnpm test 2>&1 | tail -n 20
pnpm --filter @scenelab/playground build 2>&1 | tail -n 20
